race.title: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Nursery
race.verdict: The in-form pair of PRINTING MONEY and Perfect Hope look the ones to concentrate on, with the former getting the nod. Beechwood Glory appeals as the most interesting of the rest. PRINTING MONEY (IRE) PERFECT HOPE BEECHWOOD GLORY (IRE)
